title: labels sentence case no colons above
rule: Labels: sentence case, no trailing colons, above the control.
pass_when: Visible label is sentence case, has no trailing colon, and sits above the control.
fail_when: Title Case / ALL CAPS, trailing colon, or label beside/inside as the only placement.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: LIVE visible-label existence (`forms.field_labels.visible_label`); Fluent left-align-when-tight; Polar 1–3 word cap. Overlap with Forms 54: beyond LIVE `visible_label` / `label_stays_visible`.
